newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Dreyer's raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Dreyer's raised to buy.

text.p: Hambrecht & Quist said it raised its rating on shares of Dreyer's Grand Ice Cream Inc to buy from hold due to the "apparent increase in its dollar market share of the ice cream category."
-- In a statement, the investment firm said Dreyer's has increased its market share two percent to 15.7 percent, while rival company Breyer's share has slipped by 1.2 percent.
-- Hambrecht also said its rating upgrade is based on factors like unit volume growth, the potential of a large capital infusion and logical acquisition opportunities.
-- Dreyer's shares were off 1/4 at 39-1/2 by mid-morning.
